text: In the book's modern convention, the 'relativistic mass' m_rel = γm is the fundamental Lorentz-invariant quantity and is the source of gravity in general relativity.
explanation: False. The book uses the rest mass m as the invariant (a Lorentz scalar satisfying p_μp^μ = −m²c²) and writes E = γmc², noting that 'relativistic mass' γm is deprecated because F = m_rel·a fails to hold directionally. Moreover, in GR the source of gravity is the stress-energy tensor T^μν, not any notion of mass.
